David won the last two titles. He had never started 0-3 in any season on record.
Here's whose fault that is.

His chance of making the playoffs is 15%.
The champ is likelier to run the Beer Mile than to make the playoffs.

slides.title: How the champ usually starts
slides.kicker: He has won it from 1-2. Nobody has won it from 0-3.
